Fact.Name: This claim row is answered as not eligible
Fact.Description: True when this claim row resolves one of its three eligibility checks as a decided No: the attestation (../requirementsMet) is answered No, the Form 637 registration a row requires is missing (../registrationSatisfied is false), or the type of use entered is not one the row permits (../useAllowed is false). An unanswered check is not a decided No and leaves this false, so the row just stays unfinished. Each leg is IsComplete-first, so this fact is always Complete.

Fact.Name: This activity is answered as not eligible, or holds a claim row that is
Fact.Description: True when Part I line A is answered No for this activity (../qualifyingActivity), or when any of its claim rows is answered as not eligible (../claims/*/answeredIneligible). The claim leg is read only once the claims collection is complete, so this fact is always Complete.

Fact.Name: Form 4136 holds an activity or claim row that is answered as not eligible
Fact.Description:
Blocks submission when a Form 4136 activity has Part I line A answered No, or when a claim row has its attestation answered No, lacks the Form 637 registration number its line requires, or has a type of use its line does not permit. Each of these rows earns no credit, so its credit and the Form 4136 line 17 total cannot be computed. Before this guard the return simply stayed unfinished, with nothing telling the filer why. The form itself says to stop in each case: line A No means "you aren’t eligible for the credit, don’t complete Form 4136"; a missing registration number means STOP. A row with an unanswered check is not refused here. It stays unfinished until it is answered.
IsComplete first: the activities collection must be complete, so a return with no Form 4136 resolves Complete false.
SCREEN: "One of your Form 4136 entries does not qualify for the fuel tax credit. Either you answered No to Part I line A for an activity, or a claim line is missing the registration number from Form 637 that the line requires, or it was not certified, or it lists a type of use that line does not allow. Remove that activity or claim line, or correct the answer, to continue."
